items.t: Brake booster or booster pump failure
items.job: Replace brake booster and booster pump assembly
items.note: Lexus's flat rate is 5.1 hours. Owners report about $2,000 at independent shops and $3,000-$4,600 at dealers. May be free under program 24LE01 (2014-2017) if your car still qualifies.

items.t: Head gasket leak with rattle and shaking on cold start
items.note: RepairPal lists about $2,695-$4,080. If the head or block is damaged, owners report $4,700-$9,000 or a replacement engine.
RepairPal lists about $618-$886 to replace the EGR valve. Cleaning the valve, cooler and intake ports costs mostly labor.
RepairPal lists about $332-$412 overall and $691-$794 for 2014-2017.

items.t: Exhaust heat recovery valve leaks coolant (service campaign)
items.job: Replace exhaust gas control actuator under campaign
items.note: Free under Lexus campaign CLB if your VIN is included.

items.job: Oil consumption test, then piston ring repair or engine replacement
items.note: A consumption test is cheap; owners report $7,000-$8,000 rebuild or replacement-engine quotes when rings are worn.

items.t: Oil leak from the timing chain area
items.note: One owner was quoted $3,500 at a dealer out of warranty.

items.t: Check Hybrid System warning and loss of power
items.job: Hybrid system diagnosis and battery fan cleaning
items.note: Diagnosis and fan cleaning only. A hybrid battery or inverter replacement costs much more.

items.t: Safety Connect reports the wrong location
items.note: Free under Lexus limited service campaign 19LE05.

items.t: Check engine light with throttle code P2111
items.note: RepairPal lists about $712-$815. Check bulletin L-SB-0061-12 first; the dealer fix may be simpler.

items.t: Navigation reboots or shows no traffic or weather data
